question: Should shortcut discovery be implemented as a first-party Control UI feature, a browser-local user preference, or a plugin-contributed panel/action under the Control UI contribution-slot RFC?
rationale: The request adds a new visible Control UI surface and a proposed configuration/storage contract, while current WebChat config is retired and repository direction prefers plugin/API extension paths for optional capability.

options.title: Route Through Contribution Slots
options.body: Use #71736 to define a host-owned shortcut/panel/action descriptor so skills or plugins can contribute discoverable prompt snippets without bespoke WebChat config.

options.title: Build Browser-Local First-Party Shortcuts
options.body: Add a narrow Control UI shortcut preference stored in browser storage, useful for personal snippets but not synced or plugin-discoverable.

options.title: Defer The Feature
options.body: Keep current slash commands and command palette only until maintainers are ready to own a shortcut storage and UI contract.

recommendation.title: Route Through Contribution Slots
recommendation.body: Use #71736 to define a host-owned shortcut/panel/action descriptor so skills or plugins can contribute discoverable prompt snippets without bespoke WebChat config.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the closest open RFC and merged foundation for Control UI plugin contribution surfaces that could support this without adding one-off core UI behavior.
